title: Match molecule and shape
statement:
Which pair correctly identifies the shape of BrF₅?

[_]{a}

choices: BrF₅ is octahedral as a molecular shape.
explanations: Five bonded neighbors occupy five octahedral sites.
This omits the central lone pair.
It has five bonded neighbors, not four.
This describes its electron-domain geometry only.

hints: Five bonds leave one central lone pair.
solution: Bromine contributes seven valence electrons. Five bonds leave one central lone pair. AX₅E uses six domains. Five bonded neighbors occupy five octahedral sites.
